segments.title: 第77章 歌詞真意
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Years Chapter 77 The True Meaning of the Lyrics

A little after nine in the evening.

Xu Youyu and Ying Chanxi finished washing the dishes in the kitchen and returned to their respective bedrooms.

After a quick shower, Xu Youyu sat down at her computer. Before she started writing, she opened the official QQ group for Qidian's Urban genre contracted authors and lurked, reading everyone's chat history.

Then she remembered that today seemed to be the day last month's royalties were announced.

So she hurriedly opened the writer's portal to check her royalty income.

Hmm... for her meager average of 1200 subscriptions, this income for ten days on the shelves was about normal.

After all, she wasn't a freak like Chongran, who had updated over ten thousand characters every day from the day his book went premium until the end of the month.

She was afraid that if she wasn't careful, she'd use up the manuscript of over 20,000 characters she had worked so hard to stockpile.

Things would gradually get busier after school started, so it was better to plan her use of the stockpiled chapters carefully.

A high school student, writing in her spare time, earning three to four thousand a month.

For a regular wage earner, this amount might just be a normal salary.

But for a high school student like Xu Youyu, it was an incredibly astonishing thing.

At a time when high school students generally only had an allowance for food, with no guarantee of pocket money, Xu Youyu had an extra three to four thousand in disposable funds each month.

Any ordinary person would be thrilled just thinking about it.

But Xu Youyu came from a well-off family, so she wasn't too moved by it. She was just happy to have received the royalties.

Unfortunately, there was no one in real life she could share this joy with, so Xu Youyu could only look for someone to share it with online.

Sleeping Early Makes You Taller: Great Author, look! My royalties from last month. How much did you get last month?

In the master bedroom, Li Luo, who was in the middle of writing, received this message.

Chongran: Over seven thousand.

Hiss... Xu Youyu felt a bit envious.

The thought that this guy was actually Li Luo still left Xu Youyu a bit baffled.

Earning seven thousand in a month.

We're both high school students, can't you act a little happier?

These days, it was very difficult for an ordinary person to find a job that paid seven thousand a month.

Sleeping Early Makes You Taller: What are you planning to do with the money, Great Author? Buy a new computer? Get a new phone?

Chongran: Pay the mortgage, what else.

Xu Youyu froze when she saw this sentence.

She sort of knew that Li Luo's parents had likely taken out a loan to buy this apartment, so there was definitely a mortgage.

But she subconsciously felt that paying the mortgage was the parents' responsibility and hadn't given it a thought.

But Li Luo had said it so naturally, as if it didn't pain him in the slightest.

He was usually so flippant when he spoke... Xu Youyu pursed her lips, finding it hard to connect the Li Luo she knew with the person who just said he was going to pay the mortgage.

If you act like this, doesn't it make her seem very immature?

Xu Youyu shook her head, planning to find a few other authors to share her joy of receiving royalties with.

But after reopening the QQ group for contracted authors, she found that many people were discussing the book "I'm Really Not a Superstar".

Did you guys read the latest chapter of this book? Giant Ran pulled a slick move.

Is it that new song? People are talking about it in my reader group too.

What's this? What new song?

It's from "I'm Really Not a Superstar," written by Chongran from our group.

He wrote about a song in his book before, called "Annual Ring." I think the author originally wrote it. A lot of people thought he just made up a few lines of lyrics to be pretentious and artsy, but I didn't expect him to actually come out with a new song.

It's been released on a music platform. It's on QQ Music.

Damn, it's actually pretty good?

It's okay, I guess? All I can say is that it's impressive that it's an original, but the song itself is just listenable.

Just being able to write an original song is already amazing. But have the standards for writing entertainment novels gotten this high now? Haha.

Reading the chat in the group, Xu Youyu's expression also grew curious.

When Li Luo and the others were at military training, she had been at home, furiously writing and stockpiling chapters. Even now that school had started, she didn't have much time to keep up with Li Luo's book.

Seeing this news now, Xu Youyu immediately clicked open Li Luo's book and glanced at the content at the end of the latest chapter. It really was true.

So she searched for "Annual Ring" on QQ Music and played it.

Singer: Shengsheng Buxi

Lyrics: Chongran

Music: Chongran

Arrangement: Luo Fei

Shengsheng Buxi... Could this be Yan Zhusheng?

As Xu Youyu guessed this in her mind, the melody of the song began to play in her ears.

"Circles traced into a fingerprint"

"Imprinted upon my lips"

Reading the lyrics and listening closely to the song, Xu Youyu was quickly drawn in.

After listening to it once, she opened Li Luo's book again, found the chapter where "Annual Ring" appeared, and read through it carefully.

A dozen or so minutes later, Xu Youyu let out a long breath, her expression growing even more complex.

She glanced towards the master bedroom, thinking to herself, what else was there about this guy Li Luo that she didn't know?

Did such an amazing boy really exist in this world?

How come it felt like Li Luo was good at everything he did?

Sleeping Early Makes You Taller: I just listened to your original song. I think you're amazing, it's very good.

Chongran: Thanks, I'm glad you like it.

Sleeping Early Makes You Taller: Speaking of which, a friend I know also writes songs, but his style is a bit different from yours.

Chongran: Is that so? That's pretty amazing too.

Looking at this guy Li Luo's reply, Xu Youyu found it strange. She always felt that this guy was a completely different person online than he was in real life.

How to put it... Online, Li Luo usually seemed more mature, which fit her previous conclusion that "Chongran is a middle-aged uncle."

He was like a different person from the humorous and often flippant guy he was in reality.

Sleeping Early Makes You Taller: By the way, who is this Shengsheng Buxi? Her voice is beautiful, and her vocal tone sounds a little familiar.

Chongran: Mm... she's a friend of mine. I asked her to record this song as a favor.

Looks like it really is Yan Zhusheng, huh?

Xu Youyu remembered last night, when Li Luo said Yan Zhusheng had called him. She had even taken leave from school to go home, probably to record this song.

Xu Youyu was feeling smug for having figured out the truth, while in the master bedroom, Li Luo was starting to break out in a cold sweat.

Being asked so many questions by Xu Youyu, he was afraid she would figure out his real identity.

But on second thought, Li Luo figured that without solid evidence, most people would probably never guess that the person who could write a book like "I'm Really Not a Superstar" would be a fifteen or sixteen-year-old high school student.

After thinking this through, Li Luo felt a little more at ease.

But having been interrupted by Xu Youyu, his writing momentum was broken. So Li Luo also clicked on his own book and took a look at the comment section.

What the hell? No... you're for real?

666, it's really an original song?

That guy from last time who said if the author could write original songs, why would he still be writing novels, get out here! I just want to ask, what is this "Annual Ring"?!

It's pretty good, that's amazing. In my lifetime, I can actually see an author's original new song in an entertainment novel.

I went back and re-read that part of the plot, and suddenly realized that the lyrics about tree roots and annual rings can all be connected to the plot of that fictional TV drama. The author was very thoughtful.

Why does it feel like the song was written first, and he just forced rhymes with words like "tree roots," and then fabricated a TV drama about a tree demon and a flower bud falling in love?

No, no, no, the imagery of the words "tree root," "annual ring," and "fingerprint" is used very well. They are all visually interconnected. I feel there's some substance to it.

Tree roots give off a bitter feeling, especially when they're cut in half, which is the only way to see the annual rings on them. And the contours of the annual rings look a lot like a person's fingerprint. It's indeed quite interesting.

When the person upstairs mentioned "cut in half," I suddenly remembered that in the tree demon TV show mentioned in the main text, the ending seems to be the tree demon sacrificing his demon self to extract his life essence to save the female lead, but he dies in the process, right?

And then the female lead relies on the tree roots, counting the annual rings every day, remembering the fingerprint that once landed on her lips, right? Damn, they can be connected like that?

Watching the increasingly heated discussion in the comment section, Li Luo was momentarily lost in thought.

So that was the meaning of the lyrics in "Annual Ring"?

He had only just learned it himself.

(End of Chapter)
